title: Rotate Left by K
description:
Given a list of N integers, rotate it to the left by K positions. K may be larger than N.

Input

The first line contains two integers N and K (1 ≤ N, 0 ≤ K). The second line contains N space-separated integers.

Output

Print the rotated list on one line, space-separated.
solution:
n, k = map(int, input().split())
a = input().split()
k %= n
print(' '.join(a[k:] + a[:k]))

title: Zeros to the Back
description:
Move all zeros in the list to the end while keeping the relative order of the non-zero elements.

Input

The first line contains an integer N. The second line contains N space-separated integers.

Output

Print the modified list on one line, space-separated.
solution:
n = int(input())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))
nz = [x for x in a if x != 0]
print(' '.join(map(str, nz + [0] * (n - len(nz)))))

title: Unique in Order
description:
Remove duplicate values from the list, keeping only the first occurrence of each value, in their original order.

Input

The first line contains an integer N. The second line contains N space-separated integers.

Output

Print the remaining values on one line, space-separated.
solution:
n = int(input())
seen = set()
res = []
for x in input().split():
    v = int(x)
    if v not in seen:
        seen.add(v)
        res.append(v)
print(' '.join(map(str, res)))

title: The Missing Number
description:
The numbers 1 to N were written in some order, but exactly one of them was lost. Find the missing number.

Input

The first line contains N (N ≥ 1). The second line contains N - 1 distinct space-separated integers from 1 to N (this line is empty when N = 1).

Output

Print the missing number.
solution:
n = int(input())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))
print(n * (n + 1) // 2 - sum(a))

title: Evens First
description:
Rearrange the list so that all even numbers come first, followed by all odd numbers. Within each group, keep the original relative order. Note that negative numbers can be even or odd too, and 0 is even.

Input

The first line contains an integer N. The second line contains N space-separated integers.

Output

Print the rearranged list on one line, space-separated.
solution:
n = int(input())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))
print(' '.join(map(str, [x for x in a if x % 2 == 0] + [x for x in a if x % 2 != 0])))

title: Leaders of the List
description:
An element is a leader if it is strictly greater than every element to its right. The last element is always a leader. Print all leaders in the order they appear in the list.

Input

The first line contains an integer N. The second line contains N space-separated integers.

Output

Print the leaders on one line, space-separated.
solution:
n = int(input())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))
res = []
best = None
for x in reversed(a):
    if best is None or x > best:
        res.append(x)
        best = x
print(' '.join(map(str, reversed(res))))

title: Exactly Twice
description:
Count how many distinct values appear in the list exactly two times.

Input

The first line contains an integer N. The second line contains N space-separated integers.

Output

Print the count.

title: Reverse in Groups
description:
Split the list into consecutive groups of K elements (the last group may be smaller) and reverse each group in place.

Input

The first line contains two integers N and K (1 ≤ K). The second line contains N space-separated integers.

Output

Print the resulting list on one line, space-separated.
solution:
n, k = map(int, input().split())
a = input().split()
res = []
for i in range(0, n, k):
    res += a[i:i + k][::-1]
print(' '.join(res))

title: Two Sum Indices
description:
Find two different positions i < j (0-based) such that a[i] + a[j] = T. If several pairs exist, choose the one with the smallest j; among those, the smallest i.

Input

The first line contains two integers N and T. The second line contains N space-separated integers.

Output

Print i j separated by a space, or -1 if no such pair exists.

title: Best Streak Sum
description:
Find the maximum possible sum of a non-empty contiguous sub-list.

Input

The first line contains an integer N. The second line contains N space-separated integers.

Output

Print the maximum sum.
solution:
n = int(input())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))
best = cur = a[0]
for x in a[1:]:
    cur = max(x, cur + x)
    best = max(best, cur)
print(best)

title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
description:
You are given two lists, each already sorted in non-decreasing order. Merge them into one sorted list.

Input

Four lines: N; N sorted integers; M; M sorted integers (N, M ≥ 1).

Output

Print the merged list on one line, space-separated.
solution:
n = int(input())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))
m = int(input())
b = list(map(int, input().split()))
i = j = 0
res = []
while i < n and j < m:
    if a[i] <= b[j]:
        res.append(a[i]); i += 1
    else:
        res.append(b[j]); j += 1
res += a[i:] + b[j:]
print(' '.join(map(str, res)))

title: Majority Element
description:
A majority element appears more than N / 2 times. Find it if it exists.

Input

The first line contains an integer N. The second line contains N space-separated integers.

Output

Print the majority element, or NONE if there isn't one.
solution:
n = int(input())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))
cand, c = None, 0
for x in a:
    if c == 0:
        cand = x
    c += 1 if x == cand else -1
print(cand if a.count(cand) * 2 > n else 'NONE')

title: Pairs with Difference K
description:
Count the number of distinct value pairs (x, y) with x and y taken from different positions of the list and y - x = K. Each pair of values is counted once no matter how many times the values repeat.

Input

The first line contains two integers N and K (K ≥ 0). The second line contains N space-separated integers.

Output

Print the number of distinct pairs.

title: Frequency Sort
description:
Sort the list so that values that appear more often come first. If two values have the same frequency, the smaller value comes first. Every occurrence of a value is printed (equal values stay together).

Input

The first line contains an integer N. The second line contains N space-separated integers.

Output

Print the sorted list on one line, space-separated.
solution:
n = int(input())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))
cnt = {}
for x in a:
    cnt[x] = cnt.get(x, 0) + 1
a.sort(key=lambda x: (-cnt[x], x))
print(' '.join(map(str, a)))

title: Longest Consecutive Values
description:
Find the length of the longest set of values from the list that form a run of consecutive integers (like 4, 5, 6, 7). The values may appear in any order in the list, and duplicates count only once.

Input

The first line contains an integer N. The second line contains N space-separated integers.

Output

Print the length of the longest run.
